headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty saw volatile trades while investors eye Diwali week cues and earnings.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 3 November.

why: Geopolitical risks, crude oil movement, and quarterly earnings are expected to steer upcoming market direction.
Festive demand spurred domestic PV dispatches past five-lakh units in October.
Bulls are watching for a potential rebound ahead of the Diwali week.
Foreign inflows and select heavyweight buying provided support during recent trading sessions.
whatHappening: Eicher Motors registered a 7% growth in October sales with exports surging 47%.
India's coal imports declined by 5.83% in August.
Cyber insurance claims crossed ₹150 crore while premium rates stayed soft.
ONGC announced recruitment for 3,047 apprentice vacancies.
summary:
Indian stock markets are closed today for the weekend.
Investors are assessing festive auto dispatch numbers, crude oil movements, and global cues.
Market focus shifts to upcoming corporate earnings and key drivers for the Diwali trading week.
